holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit reached ₹16,276 crore in June 2026 compared to ₹14,456 crore in June 2025.
The bank received a GST show-cause notice on September 30, 2026, demanding ₹229.14 crore plus interest and penalty.
Anup Bagchi resigned as ICICI Life MD & CEO effective October 13, 2026, with Sidharatha Mishra appointed from October 14, 2026.

expected.text: Nomura expects 17% core pre-provision operating profit growth in Q2.

holdings.why_it_matters: ICICI Bank is the fund's largest position at 8.22% weight. Its -3.3% 3-month return contributed -0.271% to portfolio performance, reflecting broad weakness across its 32.5% Financials allocation.

watch.text: Resolution of the ₹229.14 crore GST show-cause notice.

holdings.name: Reliance Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Sales reached ₹309,468 crore in June 2026, while net profit was ₹23,196 crore compared to ₹30,783 crore in June 2025.
The company allotted ₹13,008.6 crore in unsecured NCDs at a 7.90% coupon maturing October 1, 2036.
A customs order imposed a ₹18.75 lakh fine and penalty on October 7, 2026, which the company plans to appeal.

expected.text: Reports project European diesel shortages could lift Q2 O2C earnings by 38% to ₹20,700 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 5.95% fund weight, Reliance has declined -10.51% over 3 months, creating a -0.625% drag on fund returns and acting as the primary detractor in the 10.4% Energy & Utilities bucket.

watch.text: Progress and timeline regarding the public listing of Reliance Jio.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Anup Bagchi was appointed MD & CEO for three years effective October 27, 2026.
Provisional figures for September 2026 showed advances of ₹33,075 billion and deposits of ₹33,275 billion.
FIIs reduced their stake by 2.4% during the September 2026 quarter.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 5.92% of the fund, HDFC Bank dropped -14.27% over 3 months, generating the largest individual negative contribution (-0.845%) in the portfolio.

watch.text: Leadership transition as incoming CEO Anup Bagchi takes charge on October 27, 2026.

holdings.name: State Bank of India

what_changed.text: Net profit for June 2026 stood at ₹25,121 crore, up from ₹22,121 crore in June 2025.
SBI acquired nearly 40% of Reliance Industries' $1.35 billion debt offering.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 4.77% weight, SBI's -7.42% 3-month return contributed -0.354% to fund performance, reinforcing the general downtrend across the portfolio's top financial holdings.

watch.text: Corporate loan book developments following large debt allocations like the Reliance bond purchase.

holdings.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd

what_changed.text: L&T Energy CarbonLite secured an LNTP for a 2x800 MW thermal power plant in Jharkhand.
L&T PT&D secured mega EPC orders across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and India.
Completion timeline for the stake sale in L&T Metro Rail Hyderabad was extended to December 31, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: L&T makes up 4.10% of the portfolio and anchors the 10.1% Industrials exposure; its -6.15% 3-month return parallels the overall fund decline.

watch.text: Execution of order inflows from the Middle East and domestic thermal power sectors.
Completion of the L&T Metro Rail Hyderabad divestment by December 31, 2026.

holdings.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd

what_changed.text: Airtel launched updated postpaid plans on October 8, 2026, offering free annual international roaming.
Airtel Business rolled out IQ Gateway, an enterprise communications platform compliant with DPDP norms.
Net profit increased to ₹10,012 crore in June 2026 from ₹7,422 crore in June 2025.

holdings.why_it_matters: Bharti Airtel represents 3.82% of the fund and is part of an 11.4% Technology exposure; its 3-month return of -6.00% mirrors the fund's 3-month return of -6.11%.

watch.text: Customer churn and uptake following the rollout of new roaming-bundled postpaid plans.

holdings.name: Bajaj Finance Ltd

what_changed.text: Customer franchise reached 128.85 million and AUM grew 26.5% year-on-year to ₹584,750 crore in Q2 FY27.
The board approved capital raising via QIP up to ₹11,700 crore and warrants up to ₹5,800 crore.
Fixed deposit rates were increased by up to 40 bps following an RBI repo rate hike.

holdings.why_it_matters: Bajaj Finance carries a 3.33% weight in the portfolio and declined -5.93% over 3 months, further weighing on the financial sector allocation.

watch.text: Earnings results for Q2/H1 FY27 scheduled for board consideration on October 19, 2026.
Execution of the approved ₹11,700 crore QIP and warrant issues.

holdings.name: Axis Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Provisional advances stood at ₹13,846 billion and deposits reached ₹14,521 billion as of September 30, 2026.
Senior management member Sanjeev Moghe resigned, effective October 30, 2026.
June 2026 net profit rose to ₹7,670 crore from ₹6,279 crore in June 2025.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 3.07% weight, Axis Bank fell -4.88% over 3 months, adding to the cumulative negative drag across private banking names.

watch.text: Management changes following Sanjeev Moghe's departure at the end of October 2026.

holdings.name: Infosys Ltd

what_changed.text: The US government suspended PERM green card processing for several IT firms, including Infosys.
Infosys expanded AI transformation agreements with ABN AMRO and formed an AI research initiative with Columbia University.
Net profit for June 2026 was ₹7,775 crore compared to ₹6,924 crore in June 2025.

holdings.why_it_matters: Infosys holds a 2.94% fund weight and has dropped -20.82% over 6 months and -32.19% over 1 year, creating sustained pressure on the fund's 11.4% Technology sleeve.

watch.text: Upcoming Q2 results and dividend declarations.
Operational impact of the US PERM processing suspension.

holdings.name: NTPC Ltd

what_changed.text: Subsidiaries commissioned 50 MW RTC solar capacity and 153.94 MW at the Kalasar Solar Project in Rajasthan.
Total group operational capacity expanded to 91,506 MW.
Kerala State Electricity Board received approval to procure 177 MW of power from NTPC for three years.

holdings.why_it_matters: NTPC accounts for 2.59% of the fund and declined -9.45% over 3 months and -17.93% over 6 months, matching broader weakness across PSU energy holdings.

watch.text: Commercial operations of the 500 MWh battery energy storage system (BESS).
Project progress across the three identified nuclear power sites.

portfolio.statement: Kotak Large Cap Fund is heavily exposed to Financials (32.5%), Energy (10.4%), and Technology (11.4%), where broad price declines in anchor holdings drove a -6.11% 3-month return.
interp: Heavy concentration in top banking names (ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, SBI, Bajaj Finance, Axis Bank) totaled over 25% of the portfolio, compounding negative sector returns.
Positive contributions from select mid-sized allocations such as Kotak Mahindra Bank (+0.262%) and Solar Industries (+0.218%) were insufficient to offset large-cap detractors.
portfolio.line: Performance was dominated by drawdowns in top banking and energy holdings.

drivers.text: HDFC Bank contributed -0.845% following a -14.27% 3-month share price decline and foreign institutional selling.
Reliance Industries dropped -10.51% over 3 months, contributing -0.625% to fund losses.
